text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 206, May 31, 1939 ]
AUTHORIZING THE CONVERSION OF THE RURAL PROGRESS ADMINISTRATION CREATED BY
EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 191 INTO A CORPORATION
Pursuant to the authority vested in me by Commonwealth Act Numbered Three hundred seventy-eight, as
amended by Commonwealth Act Numbered Four hundred twenty, I, MANUEL L. QUEZON, President of the
Philippines, do hereby authorize the Rural Progress Administration created by Executive Order Numbered
One hundred ninety-one, dated March second, nineteen hundred and thirty-nine, to organize itself into a
corporation under the Corporation Law, with a capital of one million five hundred thousand pesos, and to
exercise not only the general powers enjoyed by corporations under the Corporation Law, but also such
powers and authority as are specified in said Executive Order Numbered One hundred ninety-one and those
which the President may, from time to time, see fit to vest in it to enable it to carry out the purposes for which
it has been created.
Done at the City of Manila, this thirty-first day of May, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
thirty-nine, and of the Commonwealth of the Philippines, the fourth.
MANUEL L. QUEZON
President of the Philippines
By the President:
JORGE B. VARGAS
Secretary to the President
